QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Barricade Brothers
QuestInfo.0: What could Glimmer Man want with you? Talk with him and find out.
QuestInfo.1: Glimmer Man says he cannot reach the Barricade Brothers, whom he hired to investigate Subani's Legacy. He asks you to bring back an interim report from them. Look for John Barricade somewhere in NLC's Clocktower.
QuestInfo.2: You met John Barricade at the Clocktower in NLC.

npc.0: Assuming he's around, you should find John Barricade at the Clocktower in NLC. Whatever they've found out, don't whisper it to a soul. Come back straightaway and tell me.
